Title: Telepathic misdirection after on the qui vive

Messages.Author: Achivai
Messages.Body:
www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=288

www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=1704

Telepathic misdirection: "...Tap this reacting vampire..."

On the qui vive: "...This reacting minion can play reaction cards and attempt to block as though untapped..."

Can I play telepathic misdirection with on the qui vive? I am playing it "as though untapped" but I am still tapped and can not pay the tap "cost" that the card requires.

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
It's just "Tap this vampire." not "Tap this vampire to...", so you can play it after On the Qui Vive just fine.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Achivai wrote:
> can not pay the tap "cost" that the card requires.
>
As a-e said, tapping the vampire is not part of the cost of playing Telepathic Misdirection, just an effect (difference between "tap to" and "tap")
